title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (10/20): Summer Sweet Soup
note_en: 无论……都…… means "no matter...": 无论 opens the condition, which usually contains a question word like 多么 or 什么, and 都 in the main clause says the result holds in every case. In 无论生活多么艰难，都不要轻易卖掉属于自己的珍贵记忆 "No matter how hard life gets, never sell your precious memories lightly," leaving out 都 would sound unfinished, even though English has no word in that spot.
